description: Competitors ranked by how often the engines named them, with `answers_without_you`: answers that named them and never mentioned you. That is the actionable column, because 'named in 48 answers' is a fact about them and 'named in 47 answers that never mentioned you' is a fact about the customer. Pass quotes=1 for up to three supporting sentences each; leave it off when summarising, or a report becomes a transcript. RULES: a null rate means NOT ENOUGH ANSWERS YET, never zero — never render it as 0%. Engines are reported separately and must never be averaged into one score.

brand.description: Which brand to report on, from list_brands. REQUIRED when the organisation has more than one brand: omitting it returns brand_required rather than guessing, because a silent default would file one customer's numbers under another's.

quotes.description: Include up to 3 quoted sentences per competitor. Off by default.

name: list_competitors
title: Who gets named instead of you
